description: Land Acquisition - Pahala Andarawewa, Hambanthota D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land (Lots 1-59) are needed for a public purpose. The document provides detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property-related matters. While a government minister is named, this is only in their capacity to declare the land acquisition under statutory authority, and the core content is exclusively about land matters rather than government personnel or organizational changes.
